usdRate.sourceName: BCEAO, rates of foreign currencies against the CFA franc for transfers, 30 October 2026
usdRate.note: Mid-point of the buying (585.50) and selling (592.50) rates for the US dollar; the CFA franc is pegged at 655.957 per euro. World Bank 2025 average 581.9.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: BCEAO, Note de conjoncture économique des pays de l'UEMOA, September 2026 (national harmonised CPI, Guinea-Bissau)
inflation_cpi.note: Consumer prices fell 0.5% year on year in Guinea-Bissau in August 2026, after 0.0% in July (INE data via BCEAO); the 2025 average was +0.9% (World Bank).

inflation_projection.sourceName: BCEAO inflation target band of 1-3%; CFA franc pegged to the euro
inflation_projection.note: Guinea-Bissau's inflation has stayed low under the euro peg, so the 2% centre of the BCEAO's 1-3% target band is used for long-range plans.

policy_rate.sourceName: BCEAO, Note de conjoncture économique des pays de l'UEMOA, September 2026 (Monetary Policy Committee of 9 September 2026)
policy_rate.note: Main policy rate held at 3.00% (marginal lending facility 5.00%) by the Monetary Policy Committee on 9 September 2026; common to all eight UMOA countries.

savings_account_rate.note: No average rate on ordinary savings accounts in Guinea-Bissau was found; the BCEAO bank-conditions survey (first half 2026) lists term-deposit and contractual-savings rates only.

fdr_3m_rate.sourceName: BCEAO, conditions créditrices of UMOA credit institutions, first half 2026 (Guinea-Bissau)
fdr_3m_rate.note: Median of the minimum term-deposit rates (taux DAT minimum) declared to the BCEAO by Guinea-Bissau's 6 banks, range 2.25-3.50%; the minimum usually applies to small, short deposits. Not a tenor-specific average.

fdr_1y_rate.note: The BCEAO bank-conditions survey gives only minimum (median 3.25%) and maximum (median 6.4%, range 4.0-6.75%) term-deposit rates per bank in Guinea-Bissau for the first half of 2026, not a 1-year rate.

dps_rate.sourceName: BCEAO, conditions créditrices of UMOA credit institutions, first half 2026 (Guinea-Bissau, épargne contractuelle)
dps_rate.note: Median rate on contractual savings plans declared by Guinea-Bissau's banks in the first half of 2026; five of six declare 3.50% (range 3.50-3.75%).

bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: No Guinea-Bissau average deposit rate was found: the BCEAO Note de conjoncture (September 2026) gives only the UMOA-wide average (5.15% in July 2026) and says Guinea-Bissau's rate fell 1.46 points in the month without giving its level; the World Bank FR.INR.DPST series for Guinea-Bissau stops in 2016 (6.9%).

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No government savings certificate sold to individuals was found; the Treasury borrows through UMOA-Titres auctions and regional public bond offers, open to individuals only through banks and brokers.

tbill_91d_rate.sourceName: UMOA-Titres, Guinea-Bissau yield curve (zero coupon) at 23 October 2026
tbill_91d_rate.note: 3-month zero-coupon rate 5.33% (5.41% after smoothing); 1-year 5.61%. No recent Guinea-Bissau 3-month auction result page could be read.

tbond_5y_rate.sourceName: UMOA-Titres, Guinea-Bissau yield curve (zero coupon) at 23 October 2026

tbond_10y_rate.note: The UMOA-Titres Guinea-Bissau yield curve (23 October 2026) stops at 7 years (7.04%); no 10-year rate was found.

tax_bank_interest.note: The withholding tax on bank interest for individuals in Guinea-Bissau could not be confirmed: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries has no Guinea-Bissau page and the tax authority's texts were not reached.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No government savings certificate exists, and the tax treatment of Treasury security interest for individuals could not be confirmed from an official source.

deposit_insurance_limit.sourceName: UMOA Council of Ministers, Decision of 30 June 2017 on FGD-UMOA contribution rates and compensation ceilings
deposit_insurance_limit.note: Deposits are guaranteed up to 1,400,000 FCFA per depositor per bank (300,000 FCFA at a microfinance institution) by the regional deposit guarantee fund; the decision dates from 2017 (older than 2025), and no later change was found.

credit_card_rate_cap.sourceName: BCEAO, conditions débitrices of UMOA credit institutions, first half 2026 (Guinea-Bissau)
credit_card_rate_cap.note: Median maximum lending rate (taux débiteur maximum) declared by Guinea-Bissau's 6 banks for the first half of 2026 (range 12-15%); it applies to all bank credit, including cards. No card-specific rate is published.

equity_return_low.sourceName: BCEAO monthly economic note, September 2026 (regional stock exchange BRVM); UMOA-Titres Guinea-Bissau yield curve
equity_return_low.note: Low case: regional (BRVM) equities return about the bank deposit rate, as in their weak 2016-2020 years.

equity_return_base.sourceName: BCEAO monthly economic note, September 2026 (regional stock exchange BRVM); UMOA-Titres Guinea-Bissau yield curve
equity_return_base.note: Base case: about 3.5 points above after-tax term deposits and 1-year bills (about 4.5%), within the 4-point cap; Guinea-Bissau has no exchange of its own, so equity means regional BRVM funds, whose 10-year record is mixed.

equity_return_high.sourceName: BCEAO monthly economic note, September 2026 (regional stock exchange BRVM)
equity_return_high.note: High case: the BRVM repeats a strong decade like 2023-2026.

gold_return_low.sourceName: BCEAO transfer rates (CFA franc pegged at 655.957 per euro); dollar gold trend
gold_return_low.note: Low case: flat gold in euro terms.

gold_return_base.sourceName: BCEAO transfer rates (CFA franc pegged at 655.957 per euro); dollar gold trend
gold_return_base.note: Base case: the long-run dollar gold trend of about 4% a year plus a small allowance for the euro-pegged franc weakening against the dollar.

gold_return_high.sourceName: BCEAO transfer rates (CFA franc pegged at 655.957 per euro); dollar gold trend
gold_return_high.note: High case: strong gold years such as 2024-2025.

fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: small term deposits or contractual savings at about 3.25-3.5%, less a possible tax on interest.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: BCEAO bank-conditions survey, first half 2026; UMOA-Titres Guinea-Bissau curve (1-year 5.61%)
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: larger term deposits (median maximum 6.4%) or 1-year Treasury bills (5.6%) through a bank, less tax on interest, rounded down because the tax rate is unconfirmed.

fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: 3-5 year Treasury bonds at about 8%, less a possible tax and an allowance for Guinea-Bissau's higher credit risk.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: CIMA (the regional insurance regulator) and Guinea-Bissau's insurance directorate publish no industry-wide life claim settlement ratio that could be found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: No published term life premium rates per 1,000 FCFA of cover by age were found from a public source; the life insurance market is very small.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical cost of a major private hospital stay in Guinea-Bissau was found.

health_premium_table.note: No published private health insurance premiums by age were found from a public source.

oop_health_share.sourceName: World Bank WDI, out-of-pocket expenditure (% of current health expenditure), Guinea-Bissau
oop_health_share.note: 61.6% in 2023 (WHO Global Health Expenditure Database via the World Bank), the latest available; older than 2025.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: BCEAO 1-3% inflation target band; 2% planning inflation
goal_inflation_health.note: No national medical CPI series was read; private and imported medical costs usually rise faster than general prices, so 1.5 points above the 2% inflation assumption.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: BCEAO 1-3% inflation target band; 2% planning inflation
goal_inflation_education.note: No national education CPI series was read; private school fees usually rise faster than general prices, so 2 points above the 2% inflation assumption.

life_expectancy.sourceName: World Bank WDI, life expectancy at birth, total (SP.DYN.LE00.IN), Guinea-Bissau

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via populationpyramid.net
life_table_remaining.note: Secondary source of UN WPP 2024 medium variant for 2026; totals at 60, 70 and 80 are the mean of men and women (only the 65 total is published there).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: Working-age people per person 65+ = 100 / old-age dependency ratio. Old-age dependency ratios used: 5.54% in 2025 (World Bank), 6.8% in 2040 (populationpyramid.net/guinea-bissau/2040/) and 12.2% in 2065 (populationpyramid.net/guinea-bissau/2065/), giving 18.05, 14.71 and 8.2.

retirement_age_default.sourceName: US Social Security Administration, Social Security Programs Throughout the World: Africa, 2019, Guinea-Bissau (archived copy)
retirement_age_default.note: Old-age pension (pensão de velhice) of the National Social Security Institute (INPS) at 60 with at least 10 years of contributions, same for men and women; a lump sum is paid with fewer than 10 years. Secondary source read through the Internet Archive because ssa.gov refused access and the INPS site was unreachable; the 2019 edition is older than 2025 and no later change was found.

retirement_age_government.note: The retirement age of civil servants could not be confirmed from an official source.

retirement_return_low.note: Low case: small term deposits or contractual savings at about 3.5%, less a possible tax on interest.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: BCEAO bank-conditions survey, first half 2026; UMOA-Titres Guinea-Bissau curve (1-year 5.61%)
retirement_return_base.note: Base case: term deposits at 3.25-6.4% less a possible tax on interest, kept below the after-tax 1-year deposit and Treasury bill rates.

retirement_return_high.note: High case: part of the money in short Treasury bonds bought through a bank.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case: a mix earning about after-tax deposit rates.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: UMOA-Titres Guinea-Bissau yield curve; regional equity and gold assumptions above
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: a balanced mix of deposits or Treasury bonds, regional equity funds and some gold.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: UMOA-Titres Guinea-Bissau yield curve; regional equity and gold assumptions above

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: No non-contributory old-age pension for Guinea-Bissau was found; no source confirming that none exists could be read.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: No non-contributory old-age pension was found (see old_age_allowance_monthly).

gratuity_rule.note: No official text on a statutory end-of-service indemnity for private employees in Guinea-Bissau could be read (the Labour Law was not reached).

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: US Social Security Administration, Social Security Programs Throughout the World: Africa, 2019, Guinea-Bissau (archived copy)
public_pension_scheme.note: Compulsory INPS social insurance for private-sector employees (8% employee, 14% employer, also funding sickness benefits; laws of 1986 and 2007): pension from 60 after 10 years of contributions equal to 2% of average monthly earnings (best two of the last five years) per year of contributions, up to 80%; the source gives no automatic indexation of pensions and no tax rule. Civil servants have a separate scheme. 2019 edition, older than 2025.

savings_account.note: Banks offer savings accounts; no average rate is published.

fdr_3m.note: Minimum term-deposit rates of 2.25-3.50% declared to the BCEAO (first half 2026).

fdr_1y.note: Maximum term-deposit rates of 4.0-6.75% declared to the BCEAO (first half 2026); no 1-year average is published.

dps.note: Contractual savings at about 3.50% (BCEAO bank-conditions survey, first half 2026).

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No government savings certificate for individuals was found.

tbill_91d.note: Auctioned through UMOA-Titres to banks and primary dealers; individuals buy through a bank or broker.

tbond_5y.note: Auctioned through UMOA-Titres; individuals buy through a bank or broker.

tbond_10y.note: Guinea-Bissau's yield curve stops at 7 years; no 10-year bond was found.

equity_fund.note: No local exchange; residents can buy regional mutual funds investing on the BRVM through approved intermediaries.

gold.note: Gold is sold mainly as jewellery; no official bullion or coin scheme was found.

centralBank.name: Banque Centrale des États de l'Afrique de l'Ouest (BCEAO)

insuranceRegulator.name: Commission Régionale de Contrôle des Assurances (CIMA)
insuranceRegulator.note: Regional insurance regulator for the CIMA member states, Guinea-Bissau included.

insuranceComplaints.name: CIMA policyholder requests and complaints form

depositInsurance.name: Fonds de Garantie des Dépôts et de Résolution dans l'UMOA (FGDR-UMOA)
